title: Logs
summary: The logs show the backend's diagnostic messages: errors, warnings, and connection changes. Use them when something did not work as expected.

entities.text: The part of time the entries are read from: the last hour, 6 hours, 24 hours, or 7 days, counted back from now. A link from an error popup sets the range to 15 minutes either side of the error.
ERROR and WARN are problems; INFO notes connection changes and actions.
The part of the system that wrote the entry, for example icecast, liquidsoap, rotation, or api.
Links an error popup in the panel to its entry in the log. Letters, digits, and the characters + / = . _ - only.

The station's monitoring tool, when it is switched on. Its Logs dashboard searches the text of the log and the playout journal across several days and shows errors per component over time. It asks for its own login.

usage: Choose a time range, then filter by level and component. Text and request ID are applied with Refresh or Enter; the other filters apply at once. Times are shown in the station timezone. Errors also appear as popups when they happen, and each popup has an Open log link to its entries.
steps: Choose the time range, for example the last 6 hours.
Set the level to WARN to see only problems.
Filter by component, for example icecast for stream problems.
Type a word in Text to find entries whose message contains it, then press Enter or Refresh.
From an error popup, use Open log: the page opens the 30 minutes around the error and marks the entry with the popup's request ID.
Press Refresh to read new entries; the page does not update by itself. Load more reads older entries.
For several days at once, use Search in Grafana (shown only when monitoring is on). It opens in a new tab.
mistakes: Expecting the log to show everything from long ago: a range longer than the log store keeps returns only what is kept.
Expecting secrets in the log. Passwords are always masked.

example.title: Why did the stream stop?
example.text: An outage banner appeared at 14:05. Open the logs, choose the last hour, and set level WARN and component icecast. The entries show "connection lost" at 14:05 and "connected" at 14:12, with reconnect attempts in between.

range.label: Time range
range.text: Counted back from now. The presets are the last hour, the last 6 hours (the default), the last 24 hours, and the last 7 days.

level.label: Level
level.text: Minimum level: WARN shows warnings and errors.

component.label: Component
component.text: Show only entries from one part of the system.

search.label: Text
search.text: Show only entries whose message contains this text, up to 200 characters. Not case-sensitive.

request_id.label: Request ID
request_id.text: Show only the entries of one request, as the error popup shows it.
